title: Trigonometric functions on the unit circle
summary:
Visualize the trigonometric functions since, cosine, tangent, cotangent, secant , and cosecant. A movable point on the unit circle defines
the angle . Then, the values (sine), (cosine), (tangent), (cotangent), (secant), and (cosecant) - depending on the angle - are visualized as the length of the marked segments.
